cards.text: Breakfast on the beach is done, friend, and Jesus turns to Simon Peter, one of His disciples. He calls him by his full name, Simon son of John. And you know what it means when somebody uses ALL your names: something BIG is coming.

cards.question: Breakfast is over, and Jesus has a question for Simon Peter. What does He ask him?

answers.text: If Peter loves Him more than these
If Peter will keep fishing with them
If Peter knows who He really is

cards.text: Peter tells Him yes, and that Jesus knows he loves Him. And Jesus comes right back with a job for him, not a speech.

cards.question: Peter tells Jesus that he loves Him. Jesus gives him a job: feed His ___.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks a second time, "Simon son of John, do you love Me?" And Peter gives the same answer, word for word.

cards.question: After the second question, Jesus tells Peter to shepherd His sheep.

cards.text: And then, a THIRD time: "Do you love Me?" You ever answer a question, they ask it again, then AGAIN, and by round three you're checking if your mouth is even working?

cards.question: When Jesus asks Peter a third time if he loves Him, Peter is deeply ___.

cards.text: Hurt and all, Peter answers: Lord, You know all things, and You know I love You. And for the third time, Jesus gives him the job: feed My sheep.

Then Jesus says, "Truly, truly, I tell you," and friend, when He starts like that, you lean in. When Peter was young, he dressed himself and walked wherever he wanted, but when he's old, he'll stretch out his hands, and someone else will dress him.

cards.question: Jesus says that when Peter is old, someone else will dress him. Where will they lead him?

answers.text: Where he does not want to go
Wherever he asks them to go
Back home to his own boat

cards.question: Jesus says all this about Peter's old age to point to the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God.
After Jesus says all this about Peter's old age, He tells Peter to ___ Him.

cards.text: Peter turns around, and look who's tagging along right behind them. It's the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask who was going to betray Him.

cards.question: Peter sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. What does Peter ask Jesus?

cards.text: Jesus answers, "If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!" And there's that line again, friend: follow Me. Some instructions you only need to hear once, and Peter just got this one TWICE.

cards.question: Because of Jesus' answer, a rumor spread among the brothers that the disciple whom Jesus loved would not ___.
So Jesus actually said that the disciple whom Jesus loved would not die.
The passage tells us who testifies to these things and wrote them down. Who is it?

cards.text: We know his testimony is true, the passage says, and Jesus did so many more things that if all of them were written down, he supposes not even the world itself would have space for the books. The whole WORLD, friend, and I used to think the back of my old junk drawer was full.

findings.problem: The earlier cards only say that Jesus gives Peter a job. They provide no basis for choosing lambs over goats or camels, so this blank asks the baker to guess unseen wording rather than reason out the meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
